khqrRefunds.intro: Money to give back on KHQR payments: a sale that failed or was cancelled, a return back to the KHQR, a payment that came after the QR was cancelled, or a wrong amount. Each one is refunded with your PIN; nothing is refunded automatically.
khqrRefunds.checkNone: The daily check found nothing to look at.
khqrRefunds.pinBody: ABA PayWay sends the money back to the customer now. Type your PIN to confirm.
khqrRefunds.byHandBody: Bakong has no refund API: refund the customer at the bank first, then type your PIN to record it.

source.late_payment: Paid after the QR was cancelled or expired

kind.not_paid_at_provider: Recorded as paid, not paid at the bank
kind.paid_not_recorded: Paid at the bank, not recorded
kind.paid_not_used: Paid, but no sale took it
